gold_ud.reason: UD dependencies are gold annotations, but the collected files mix upstream train/dev/test. CHILDES dominates the corpus, so it is down-weighted to reduce domain skew.

tatoeba.reason: Labels are parser-generated silver data. They may be collected and audited, but are excluded from supervised model fitting and epoch selection.

mediawiki.reason: MediaWiki parser labels are collection/audit data only and are not eligible for supervised fitting.

validation_and_test.reason: Keep final/test-only corpora blind during fitting and epoch selection to avoid manual holdout-driven tuning.

weak_feed_can_be_promoted_only_if: held-out UD dev/test metrics do not regress beyond 0.3 percentage points
complex-sentence exact accuracy does not regress
source-specific error audit shows no new systematic S/O/C failure mode
regression_patch: regression train and validation text sets are disjoint
target validation contains at least 128 sentences and improves by at least 0.5 percentage points
UD dev token accuracy does not regress by more than 0.1 percentage points
UD dev sentence-exact rate does not regress by more than 0.2 percentage points
official test data is not consulted during fitting or epoch selection

lineage.r011: random-init + official train only; official dev selection; official test excluded
lineage.r012_safe: R011 + upstream gold train rows only; Tatoeba/MediaWiki silver excluded from fitting
lineage.r012_regression: separate output artifact; disjoint synthetic train/validation; 10k gold replay; token+sentence-exact safety gates; official test unused
